violated_contract: A component's CI lane must run the component's real test suite and its static gates, not a hand-maintained subset. A subset reports green while every excluded suite rots: five analyzer ERRORs, twelve failing Flutter tests (one of them a file that no longer compiled) and a duplicate-ARB-key regression that silently served untranslated English to 24 locales all merged to main behind a green `android-tests` job.
canonical_prevention: Run `flutter test --concurrency=2` (the whole hermetic suite) and `app/scripts/analyze_ratchet.sh` in the Android lane, so a new test file or analyzer rule is covered by default instead of having to be appended to a list.
